description: The Locus UI served by the bundled Next server at http://127.0.0.1:3000 (a remote origin to Tauri). Exactly the app commands it invokes (quit, updates, native confirmations) plus event listen/unlisten (app-quit-requested, update-status) and the app version. No dialog, fs, shell or other plugin permission: confirmations are native dialogs shown from Rust.
